title: Angry Villager
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel.Villagers are impatient.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel.
Villagers have zero patience. If you open a trading interface and hesitate for too long, they will get angry and actively raise their prices in real-time. If you don't buy quickly, the trade becomes incredibly expensive.
